tasks.title: Complete Project Infrastructure
tasks.description: Establish the foundational infrastructure for the Smart School Bus Tracking System, including repository setup, environment configuration, and initial project structure.
tasks.details:
- Create a Git repository for version control.
- Set up a cloud-based server environment (e.g., AWS, Azure).
- Initialize the mobile application projects for Android and iOS.
- Set up a relational database (e.g., PostgreSQL) for user and tracking data.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify repository setup by checking commit history; ensure cloud server is accessible; confirm mobile projects compile without errors.

tasks.title: Implement Real-Time GPS Tracking with WebSocket
tasks.description: Develop the core functionality for GPS-based real-time tracking of school buses using WebSocket for real-time updates.
tasks.details:
- Integrate GPS APIs for location tracking.
- Implement a service to fetch and update bus locations using WebSocket for real-time tracking.
- Create a map interface to display live bus locations.
<info added on 2025-11-26T06:31:52.662Z>
### Implementation Notes
- Use the `location-event` module and the `LocationEvent` table (fields: `busId`, `tripId`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `source`) to store GPS snapshots.
- Create a service to receive data from devices (via REST or MQTT gateway), normalize it, and emit through NestJS `WebSocketGateway` (can be placed at `backend/src/modules/location-event/gateways`).
- Frontend clients only need to subscribe to channels based on `busId`/`tripId`; persist the latest location directly in PostgreSQL (no Redis/cache layer) for history queries.
- Control the update frequency using throttling to prevent congestion (e.g., 1 update every 2 seconds per bus).
</info added on 2025-11-26T06:31:52.662Z>
tasks.testStrategy: Conduct unit tests on GPS data fetching; perform integration tests to ensure location updates reflect on the map correctly.

subtasks.title: Integrate GPS APIs for Location Tracking
subtasks.description: Set up and integrate external GPS APIs to fetch real-time location data for school buses.
subtasks.details: Research and select appropriate GPS APIs that provide real-time location data. Implement the API integration to fetch bus locations and handle the data format returned by the API. Ensure proper error handling for API requests and responses.

subtasks.title: Implement WebSocket Service for Real-Time Updates
subtasks.description: Create a WebSocket service to handle real-time updates of bus locations based on GPS data.
subtasks.details: Develop a WebSocket server that listens for incoming connections from clients. Implement functionality to send real-time updates of bus locations to connected clients whenever new data is received from the GPS API. Ensure that the service can handle multiple connections and maintain data consistency.

subtasks.title: Create Map Interface for Live Bus Locations
subtasks.description: Design and implement a user interface that displays live bus locations on a map.
subtasks.details: Utilize a mapping library (e.g., Google Maps API or Leaflet) to create a map interface. Integrate the WebSocket service to update the map in real-time as new bus location data is received. Focus on UI/UX design to ensure the map is user-friendly and visually appealing.

tasks.title: Develop Parent Notification System with Push and Email
tasks.description: Create an automated notification system for parents regarding bus pick-up and drop-off times, including push notifications and email alerts.
tasks.details:
- Implement a notification service using SMS, push notifications, and email.
- Create templates for notifications (e.g., delays, pick-up confirmations).
- Integrate with the backend to trigger notifications based on bus location data.
<info added on 2025-11-26T06:32:09.534Z>
### Implementation Notes
- Utilize the existing `notification` module (controller/service/repository) and the `NotificationType` enum to classify alerts (e.g., `warning`, `delay`, `arrival`).
- For push notifications, prioritize FCM; for emails, use SES/SendGrid; for SMS, implement Twilio (configuration within the service).
- Trigger notifications based on trip/location events: use Domain Events or directly emit from `LocationEventService` to the NotificationService.
- Log notifications in the `Notification` table to provide parents with a history in the app/web.
</info added on 2025-11-26T06:32:09.534Z>
tasks.testStrategy: Test notification delivery through unit tests; simulate various scenarios to ensure notifications are sent correctly.

subtasks.title: Set Up Notification Service

subtasks.details: Develop a notification service that can handle sending messages through SMS, push notifications, and email. Ensure that the service can manage different message formats and delivery methods effectively.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test the notification service by sending test messages through all channels and verifying delivery.

subtasks.title: Create Notification Templates

subtasks.testStrategy: Review the templates for clarity and effectiveness; conduct tests to ensure they render correctly in all notification formats.

subtasks.title: Integrate Backend for Notification Triggers

subtasks.details: Implement the integration between the notification service and the backend system. This will involve setting up triggers that activate notifications based on bus location updates and other relevant events.
subtasks.testStrategy: Simulate bus location updates and verify that notifications are triggered correctly in response to these updates.

tasks.title: Create Administrative Dashboard with API Integration
tasks.description: Develop an administrative interface for managing the school bus system, including fleet management and route planning, with API integration.
tasks.details:
- Design the dashboard UI using a web framework (e.g., React, Angular).
- Implement features for bus fleet management and route optimization.
- Integrate reporting tools for data analysis with backend APIs.
<info added on 2025-11-26T06:32:22.645Z>
### Implementation Notes
- The dashboard will retrieve data from the controllers: `bus`, `route`, `schedule`, and `admin`. Ensure each endpoint supports filtering and pagination (using DTO `paginated-query-*.dto.ts`).
- Use Automapper for mapping entities to responses (already configured in the project); avoid returning Prisma models directly.
- Fleet management will require endpoints to lock vehicles, update drivers, and view schedules (`Schedule` + `Trip`).
- Reporting will aggregate data from `Trip`, `Attendance`, and `Notification`. Consider creating a service for aggregation or using SQL views.
</info added on 2025-11-26T06:32:22.645Z>
tasks.testStrategy: Perform integration testing to ensure all dashboard features work seamlessly; validate data accuracy in reports.

tasks.title: Implement Student Management Features with Business Logic
tasks.description: Create functionalities for managing student information, attendance tracking, and secure check-in/check-out processes, focusing on business logic implementation.
tasks.details:
- Develop a student database schema to store student details and attendance records.
- Implement secure check-in/check-out processes with guardian verification, ensuring business logic is correctly applied.
<info added on 2025-11-26T06:32:39.374Z>
### Implementation Notes
- Related tables: `Student`, `ParentStudent`, `StudentSchedule`, `Attendance`. Use Prisma relations for eager loading when necessary (e.g., fetching parent information along with student data).
- The check-in/out process should log `tripId`, `stopId`, and `action` (`picked_up`, `dropped_off`, `absent`) into the `Attendance` table.
- Guardian verification: match `parentId` in `ParentStudent` and require OTP/QR for authentication.
- Business logic should be consolidated in `student.service.ts` and reused through the existing repository pattern.
</info added on 2025-11-26T06:32:39.374Z>

tasks.title: Enhance Notification System with Multiple Channels
tasks.description: Expand the notification system to include emergency alerts and two-way communication channels, implementing push notifications, email, and SMS.

- Create a two-way communication system for parents and drivers, utilizing push notifications, email, and SMS.
<info added on 2025-11-26T06:32:51.387Z>
### Implementation Notes
- Emergency alerts should be sent directly through push/SMS with high priority, bypassing slow queues.
- For two-way chat, create new tables (e.g., `Conversation` + `ConversationMessage`) or reuse `Notification` with a thread flag.
- Implement middleware rate-limiting to prevent spam from parents; ensure complete logging in `Notification` or chat tables.
- Define SLAs for each channel (push < 5s, SMS < 20s) and monitor using Prometheus/Grafana.
</info added on 2025-11-26T06:32:51.387Z>

tasks.title: Implement Security Measures with Enhanced Authentication
tasks.description: Establish security protocols to protect sensitive user data and ensure compliance with privacy regulations, enhancing authentication mechanisms.
tasks.details:
- Implement data encryption for transmission and storage.
- Set up secure user authentication and access control mechanisms, including refresh token and password reset features.
- Conduct regular security audits and vulnerability assessments.
<info added on 2025-11-26T06:33:04.033Z>
### Implementation Notes
- Leverage existing guards (`jwt-auth.guard.ts`, `roles.guard.ts`) and extend the `auth` module to support refresh tokens stored in PostgreSQL (create a `RefreshToken` table or reuse an auth-specific table).
- Password reset flow: create an endpoint to send email OTP using NotificationService or a standalone email service.
- Encryption: use `bcrypt` for passwords, TLS for the API gateway, and consider a simple secrets file (or Vault later) for credential storage.
- Security audit: integrate `helmet`, `rate-limiter`, and log audits into a separate table or SIEM service.
</info added on 2025-11-26T06:33:04.033Z>
tasks.testStrategy: Perform security testing to identify vulnerabilities; ensure compliance with privacy regulations through audits.

subtasks.title: Implement Data Encryption for User Data

subtasks.details: Utilize encryption standards such as AES for data at rest and TLS for data in transit. Ensure that encryption keys are managed securely and comply with industry standards.

tasks.title: Complete Frontend-Backend API Integration
tasks.description: Integrate all frontend pages with backend APIs to ensure full functionality and data handling.
tasks.details:
Implement API calls for all CRUD operations across the admin, driver, and parent pages. Ensure proper error handling for API responses and implement loading states to enhance user experience. The integration should include: 
- Fetching data from the backend for displaying on frontend pages. 
- Sending user inputs from the frontend to the backend for processing. 
- Handling API errors gracefully and providing user feedback. 
- Implementing loading indicators during API calls to improve user experience.
<info added on 2025-11-26T06:33:39.403Z>
### Implementation Notes
- The frontend currently uses an Axios instance (`frontend/src/api/api.js`). Create a service layer that matches the IDs of the backend modules (users, bus, route, etc.).
- Ensure that all APIs returning a `PageableResponseDto` are correctly mapped to `data/meta` on the frontend.
- For error handling, intercept Axios responses to catch 401/403 errors and automatically log out or refresh the token.
- For loading indicators, consider using context/global reducer to toggle the spinner during API calls.
</info added on 2025-11-26T06:33:39.403Z>
tasks.testStrategy: Conduct unit tests for each API integration to ensure correct data handling. Perform integration tests to verify that the frontend correctly communicates with the backend. Simulate various scenarios, including successful and failed API calls, to ensure robust error handling and user feedback mechanisms.

tasks.title: Complete Business Logic Implementation for All Modules
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive business logic for all 16 modules in the backend services, ensuring validation, error handling, and business rules are fully integrated.
tasks.details:
Each module requires the implementation of specific business rules, validation checks, and error handling mechanisms. This includes defining the logic for data processing, ensuring that all inputs are validated against defined criteria, and handling any errors that may arise during processing. The implementation should follow best practices for code organization and documentation to facilitate future maintenance and updates.
<info added on 2025-11-26T06:33:53.134Z>
### Implementation Notes
- Each of the 16 modules corresponds to 16 main tables in Prisma; ensure each module includes: DTO validation (using class-validator), a service for business logic processing, and a repository for Prisma interactions.
- Prioritize implementation in clusters: (Users/Auth/Admin), (Route/StopPoint/Itinerary/Schedule), (Trip/Attendance/LocationEvent), (Notification/Parent modules).
- Utilize Automapper to convert entities to response DTOs, preventing exposure of sensitive information.
- Write unit tests concurrently (Task 11) to lock behavior when adding business rules.
</info added on 2025-11-26T06:33:53.134Z>
tasks.testStrategy: Conduct unit tests for each module's business logic to ensure that all validation rules are correctly enforced and that error handling works as intended. Perform integration tests to verify that the business logic interacts correctly with the existing API endpoints and that the overall system behaves as expected under various scenarios.

tasks.title: Create API Documentation with Swagger
tasks.description: Develop comprehensive Swagger/OpenAPI documentation for all backend APIs.
tasks.details:
This task involves creating detailed API documentation using Swagger for all existing backend endpoints. The documentation should include descriptions of each endpoint, request and response schemas, authentication requirements, and examples of usage. Ensure that the documentation is clear, concise, and accessible for developers who will be integrating with the APIs. Utilize Swagger UI to present the documentation in an interactive format, allowing users to test endpoints directly from the documentation. Review existing API implementations to ensure all details are accurately captured.
<info added on 2025-11-26T06:34:14.663Z>
### Implementation Notes
- Use `@nestjs/swagger` (already in devDependencies). The documentation will be generated in `main.ts` using `DocumentBuilder`, exposing the endpoint at `/api/docs`, protected by Basic Auth if necessary.
- Group endpoints by module (Auth, Users, Bus, Route, Trip, Notification, etc.). Each DTO should include the `@ApiProperty` decorator to clearly display the schema.
- Generate an OpenAPI JSON file to share with the mobile/web team using `SwaggerModule.createDocument`.
- Ensure documentation is automatically updated in CI to prevent discrepancies with the code.
</info added on 2025-11-26T06:34:14.663Z>
